data.title: Increase of statutory health/long-term care insurance contribution
data.summary: Musterquell Krankenkasse informs Johanna Beispielacker that, as a voluntarily insured member, her monthly health and long-term care insurance contribution will rise to €318.46 from 1 January 2027, due to a new supplementary contribution rate and her income shown in her 2025 tax assessment. The letter includes a right to object (Widerspruch) within one month of notification.
data.explanation: Your health insurer is raising your monthly contribution to €318.46 starting 1 January 2027 because of a higher supplementary contribution rate and your reported income. You may decide whether to accept this or file an objection (Widerspruch) with the Krankenkasse; the app shows the deadline for that until when you can still act. If you do nothing by then, the new amount becomes final. The contribution will continue to be collected by direct debit around the 15th of the following month, so make sure your account has sufficient funds. This is routine and generally does not need legal advice unless you believe the income used is wrong.
